budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Jeffreys stated there is roughly $70,000 to invest in the library trust funds; the Library Director said the Town has a large cushion and can avoid touching principal.
budget_items.quote: mr. jeffreys stated there is roughly $70,000 to invest.

budget_items.topic: Old Primary School hazardous materials abatement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The final Hazardous Materials survey report identifies a cost to abate the hazardous materials.
budget_items.quote: the report identifies a cost of $37,875.00 to abate the identified hazardous materials.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Twelve bids were received for the DPW roof project, with the low and high bids printed.
budget_items.quote: with the low bid of $84,000 and a high bid of $137,500

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The roof project was in the FY19 Capital Plan at $65,000; the balance of $19,000 will be subsidized from the Facilities budget.
budget_items.quote: this was a project in the fy19 capital plan in the amount of $65,000 and we will need to subsidize the balance of $19,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager said the roof balance would come from earmarked engineering funds not being used for the rest of the year, which are anticipated excess funds of the current fiscal year.
budget_items.quote: we had earmarked funds for engineering services to help with projects and that is not going to be used for the remaider of the year.

budget_items.topic: Recycling Education and Enforcement Coordinator grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A part-time MassDEP grant-funded position of $30,000 over 24 months, requiring a 25% match from participating towns.
budget_items.quote: that would be a $30,000 grant from massdep for a 24 month period and would require a 25% match from the towns participating.

budget_items.topic: Recycling coordinator match cost by number of sharing towns
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Cost to the Town if shared with one other town is $3,750 total ($1,875 each year); with two other towns $2,500 total ($1,250 each year); both paid from the Recycling Dividends Program grant.
budget_items.quote: if we shared this with one other town it would cost a total of $3,750 ($1,875 each year).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Sub-Committee set the assessment at $198,530, a decrease from the budgeted estimate.
budget_items.quote: the assessment will be $198,530. the original estimate in the budget was $213,497, so this is a decrease of $14,967.

budget_items.topic: Pay as You Throw Program (operating budget)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Amount for operating the Pay as You Throw Program for the Town's portion of trash disposal and recycling pickup, through the operating budget.
budget_items.quote: of $206,000. ms. lemieux stated this is to operate the pay as you throw program for the town's portion of trash disposal and recycling pickup (through the operating budget).

budget_items.topic: Public Education Government Enterprise Fund amounts
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board asked about $191,000 for operating and $120,000 for capital of the enterprise fund; Town Manager said these are enterprise fund collections, not town funds.
budget_items.quote: ms. luck asked about the $191,000 requested for operating the public education government enterprise fund and $120,000 for the capital budget for the same enterprise fund.

budget_items.topic: Accounts payable, deductions and payroll warrants
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed three warrants: accounts payable, deductions and payroll.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $374,364.44; a deductions warrant in the amount of $577,377.60; a payroll warrant in the amount of $828,095.27.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Senior Tax Workoff committee voted to raise the hourly wage to the state minimum wage; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: they did meet recently and voted to increase the hourly wage to be the same as the state minimum wage.
